page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.26xlarge is a memory-optimized virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by a 2.5 GHz Intel Xeon 8269CY processor utilizing the x86_64 architecture with 104 dedicated virtual CPUs. The instance provides 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 7.38 GB of RAM per vCPU, designed specifically for workloads with massive working set requirements.

Network throughput is configured with a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps. The instance includes no local storage and does not feature hardware GPU acceleration, requiring reliance on external cloud storage volumes for all disk operations and state persistence. With 104 dedicated compute cores alongside its substantial memory allocation, it offers significant resource density for memory-bound applications without the overhead of physical hardware management.

Given the high memory capacity and multi-core density, the ecs.r6.26xlarge is suited for running large-scale in-memory databases, distributed caching layers, intensive enterprise analytics, and big data processing clusters where data sets exceed standard compute profiles.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.r6.26xlarge is a high-capacity, memory-optimized virtual server instance based on the KVM hypervisor. Built upon an x86_64 Intel Xeon 8269CY processor running at 2.5 GHz, the configuration delivers 104 dedicated vCPUs coupled with 768.0 GB of memory, maintaining an allocation ratio of 7.38 GB per vCPU. Network connectivity provides a baseline bandwidth of 25 Gbps. The instance provision contains zero integrated local storage and no hardware GPU accelerators, delegating persistent storage tasks to network-attached block devices. With high compute core counts and massive RAM provisioning, ecs.r6.26xlarge is structured for memory-heavy enterprise workloads, including large-scale in-memory databases, real-time data caching, large batch analytics pipelines, and distributed memory-intensive enterprise processing systems.
